findings.title: Revenue Growth and Seasonality
findings.evidence: Total Revenue: $19,316,269.00 AUD. Average Monthly Revenue: $804,844.54 AUD. Revenue Growth (2024-2025): 88.13%
findings.method: Time series analysis of monthly revenue
findings.business_significance: The company shows consistent revenue growth, indicating successful market expansion and customer acquisition. Understanding seasonality can help optimize inventory and marketing spend.
findings.limitations: Data limited to 2024-2025; external economic factors not considered.

findings.title: Product Performance and Margins
findings.evidence: Top Product by Revenue: Product 01 ($1,794,392.60). Average Profit Margin: 32.39%. Products with Negative Margin: 2.
findings.business_significance: Premium products drive revenue but may have lower margins. Identifying margin erosion helps in pricing strategy and product mix optimization.
findings.limitations: Margin calculation based on reported unit costs; potential cost data quality issues.

findings.title: Regional Performance Variance
findings.evidence: Top Region by Revenue: North ($5,337,481.68). Average Regional Profit Margin: 32.44%.
findings.business_significance: Regional performance varies significantly, suggesting opportunities for targeted marketing and logistics optimization in underperforming regions.
findings.limitations: Regional definitions may not reflect true market segments; shipping distance may not fully explain performance differences.

findings.title: Customer Segment Analysis
findings.evidence: Enterprise Segment Revenue: $5,878,013.70. SMB Segment Revenue: $5,892,126.83. Consumer Segment Revenue: $7,546,128.47.
findings.method: Customer segment aggregation and comparative analysis
findings.business_significance: Enterprise customers contribute significantly to revenue, but SMB and Consumer segments may offer growth opportunities. Understanding segment preferences helps in product development and marketing.
findings.limitations: Segment definitions are arbitrary; customer lifetime value not considered.

findings.title: Operational Efficiency and Delivery Performance
findings.evidence: On-Time Delivery Rate: 76.35%. Average Delivery Days: 3.38. Average Profit Margin: 32.47%.
findings.business_significance: Delivery performance impacts customer satisfaction and repeat business. Improving on-time delivery can enhance customer loyalty and reduce operational costs.
